summary: Ocugen filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing an exclusive license and commercial supply agreement with Roots Pharmaceutical for OCU400, a modifier gene therapy for retinitis pigmentosa, across certain Middle East and North Africa countries. Ocugen receives an upfront fee, up to $4 million in development and regulatory milestones, up to $255 million in sales milestones, and a 22% royalty on net sales. Roots controls regional regulatory filings and commercialization. The license continues until the latest of 20 years post-first commercial sale, patent expiration, or market exclusivity. This is a routine licensing transaction, not a special situation.
